title: PicardExternalCoefficientsPushforwardCoproduct
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X,Y schemes [def-pc-scheme], and f:X -> Spec(k), g:Y -> Spec(k) morphisms. Assume X is quasi-compact and f has affine diagonal. Let F,G be quasi-coherent modules on X,Y [pqf-def-coherent]. Put E=pr1^*F tensor pr2^*G [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. The ordinary module direct image pr2_*E [pqf-def-cohomology] admits maps iota_i:G -> pr2_*E indexed by a type I in the schemes universe which exhibit it as a coproduct of the constant family G in the module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Neither coefficient needs to be acyclic and Y need not be quasi-compact or have affine diagonal.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine-open calculation and degree-zero direct-image formula; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

proof.text: Choose a basis b indexed by a type I in universe w of the k-vector space Gamma(X,F). The scalar action is the recorded scalarObj f F at the top open. For each b_i, the external product with a section t of G on V defines a section of pr2_*E on V. The tensor-pullback adjunction units and tensor-section formulas ensure these maps are O_Y(V)-linear and commute with restriction, so they define module-sheaf maps iota_i:G -> pr2_*E.

On each affine V of Y, identify the inverse-image open with X times V and E restricted there with the external coefficients for F and G restricted to V. Open-immersion pullback agrees with restriction and composition, including its units. Apply the affine-right external section comparison to get Gamma(X,F) tensor_k G(V) isomorphic to (pr2_*E)(V). Its explicit pure-tensor formula identifies the maps iota_i with t maps to b_i tensor t.

Basis expansion identifies the tensor module on every affine V with the algebraic direct sum of copies of G(V). In the presheaf category the direct sum is pointwise. Sheafify its coproduct cofan; sheafification is a left adjoint and therefore preserves its colimit. The maps iota_i induce a morphism from this sheaf coproduct to pr2_*E. Its source presheaf comparison is an isomorphism on the affine basis, so its stalk maps are invertible (every germ can be represented on an affine neighbourhood; equality of germs can be tested after shrinking to another such neighbourhood). Sheafification does not change stalks, and stalks detect isomorphisms. Transport the sheaf coproduct cofan through this isomorphism. An empty basis gives the zero coproduct. No acyclicity, compactness of Y, or equality of arbitrary open sections with an infinite direct sum is asserted.

theorem picardExternalCupCoefficients_pushforward_coproduct
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)]
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    : ∃ (I : Type w)
      (ι : ∀ _ : I, G ⟶ (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
        (pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)),
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk _ ι))
